death_clustering.upstream_rationale: Describes what the player does on respawn.
death_clustering.verification: share of your death-to-death gaps at or under 90 seconds

deaths_alone_share.upstream_rationale: Describes how the player moves, not what the scoreboard did.
deaths_alone_share.verification: share of your death minutes with no team kill activity

fight_conversion.upstream_rationale: The measurement records a team result, but the behaviour behind it is the player's own decision after a won fight: go to the tower, or go back to the jungle. Weighted low because the result is not theirs alone.
fight_conversion.verification: rate a won fight minute is followed by an enemy tower falling

first_real_item_time.upstream_rationale: A purchase is an action the player takes alone.
first_real_item_time.verification: time of your first real-item purchase

first_ward_time.upstream_rationale: A ward placement is an action the player takes alone.
first_ward_time.verification: time of your first observer ward placement

lane_vs_jungle_share.upstream_rationale: Where the player chooses to farm.
lane_vs_jungle_share.verification: share of your creep gold taken from neutrals

last_hits_at_ten.upstream_rationale: Pure execution inside the player's own lane.

spike_usage.upstream_rationale: Same judgement as fight_conversion, and weighted lower for the same reason: whether a kill follows is not the player's alone, but seeking the fight once the item lands is.
spike_usage.verification: seconds from your first real item to your next kill or assist

vision_coverage.upstream_rationale: Ward uptime is a purchasing and placement habit.
vision_coverage.verification: share of minutes with one of your observer wards alive

downstream_exclusions.closer_vs_comeback: win rate given a lead is the result itself; recommending it is circular
downstream_exclusions.lane_to_map: net worth at minute 20 is a scoreboard reading, not a behaviour
downstream_exclusions.lead_retention: whether a lead survives is a team outcome the player receives

outcome_contaminated_exclusions.death_clustering: gap runs the same way for 260 of 263 players (modal-sign share 0.9886)
outcome_contaminated_exclusions.fight_conversion: gap runs the same way for all 262 players (modal-sign share 1.0000)
